integrity: The proof supplies an explicit injective family of self-shuffles, an exact generating-function count of that family, and the universal fixed-weight upper bound. A standalone verifier reconstructs the shuffle certificates, checks injectivity through the zero-run inverse map, and exhaustively reproduces published small fixed-weight counts.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the fixed-weight polynomial order for every fixed k but not the leading asymptotic constant for k>=2 or an exact formula.
title: Fixed-weight binary shuffle squares have full polynomial order
